summary.text: Bob Hallstrom is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 1, serving since 2024. His committee assignments are Banking, Commerce and Insurance and Judiciary.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Hallstrom was born December 2, 1955, in Syracuse and graduated from Syracuse-Dunbar-Avoca High School in 1974.
His biography lists his occupation as attorney and membership in Luther Memorial Church, and past membership in the Syracuse Area Jaycees.
It lists him as married to LuRae Speckmann since December 14, 1985, with four children.
